online.account.title: My account
online.account.unavailable: The network client is not available in this version.
online.account.purpose: Your account is used to share your songs and to play in rooms. DodoTopia only reads your Discord username, avatar and ID.
online.account.logout_body: You will also leave the current room. Your local songs are not affected.
online.account.waiting_code: enter this code on the page that opens, then authorize DodoTopia.
online.account.waiting_link: open the link in your browser and authorize DodoTopia.
online.account.code_label: Enter this code on the page that opens
online.account.link_help: The link also works from a phone{has_expiry, select, yes { · it expires in {min} min} other {}}. Never enter a code someone sent you.
online.account.blocked_server: Server unreachable: signing in is not possible right now.
online.account.blocked_old: Update DodoTopia to sign in (minimum version {version}).
online.account.no_account: Music, drawing and cooking work without an account. A Discord account is only used to share your songs and to play in rooms with other players.
online.update.source_hint: Running from source: replace the files by hand.
online.discover.not_in_library: Song not found in your library
online.discover.for_room_title: Pick this song for your room
online.discover.offline_notice: Server unreachable{has_reason, select, yes {: {reason}} other {}}. Your library, drawing and cooking keep working.
online.discover.too_old: Update DodoTopia to use the catalogue and rooms (minimum version {version}).
online.discover.unavailable:
Catalogue unavailable.
It needs a reachable server; your library remains usable.
online.discover.no_match: {has_query, select, yes {No song matches “{query}”.} other {No song matches.}}
online.discover.empty_prompt: Search for a song, or click “Refresh” to load the catalogue.
online.discover.share_hint.anonymous: Getting a song does not require an account. To share yours, sign in from the avatar at the top right.
online.discover.share_hint.logged: To share one of your songs: “My library” view, “More actions” menu on the song’s row, then “Share”.
online.moderation.title: Administration
online.moderation.restricted: This area is reserved for the server administrators.
online.moderation.intro: Review queue and reports for the shared catalogue. Published songs then appear in “Discover songs” for everyone.
online.moderation.reject_reason_label: Reason (shown to the person who submitted it)
online.moderation.remove_body: {title} will be removed from the shared catalogue. People who already downloaded it keep it.
online.account.delete_body: Your account is removed from the server. Songs already published stay in the library without your name; pending or rejected ones are erased. Your local songs are not affected. This cannot be undone.
online.discover.no_match_tag: No song with the “{tag}” tag yet.
online.like.need_account: Log in with Discord (avatar at the top right) to like.
online.import.title: Import from a link
online.import.intro: Paste a song link: the DodoTopia server fetches the MIDI file and adds it to your library.
online.import.label: Song link
online.import.rights: Only import songs you're allowed to use. Nothing is published: the file stays in your library.
online.import.need_account: Link import goes through your Discord account: log in first (avatar at the top right).
online.import.started: Importing: the song will open as soon as it's ready.
online.sharef.rights: I have the right to share this file
online.license.own_help: You wrote or arranged this file yourself.
online.license.public_domain_help: A work free of rights (for example, a composer who died long ago).
online.license.cc_help: The author allows sharing: give the source above.
online.license.unknown_help: A moderator will check: at least say where the file comes from.
